acceptanceCriteria.text: Every candidate is transformed only through the single Suzukuri companion.
Stable candidate/source/projection/version inputs replay to stable C3 and `prefix_id`.
Source generation or meaning-affecting projection/component version change invalidates C3.
Unselected unrelated source change leaves C3 unchanged.
Budget/completeness/loss metadata is retained deterministically and boundedly.
Generic-text appears only when explicitly selected.
No local or Context Runtime semantic reducer is introduced.

issue.title: feat(canon): project selected C3 candidates through Suzukuri into Canon
